Anya (eng-platform): Heads up — after the midnight traffic ramp I noticed eu-west pools had sustained queue_depth while us-west was mostly idle. looks like routing + cooldown interaction. :thinking:
Rahul (eng-infra): same. cost-routing favored us-west so the traffic ended up there but the autoscaler in eu-west didn't scale fast enough. curious about batch-window effects too.
Mike (eng-oncall): can you paste the grafana/pql you used? want to check correlations with gpu_util and scale events. :eyes:
Anya (eng-platform): pasted below — simple rolling rate + capacity normalization, gives per-pool pressure.
```promql
sum(rate(requests_queued_total{job="queue"}[5m])) by (pool, region)
/
max(1, avg_over_time(gpu_instances_allocated{pool!=""}[30m])) by (pool, region)
```
Elaine (eng-sre): ok that helps. propose we surface a derived metric `queue_fairness_ratio` = max_pool_ratio / median_pool_ratio for a region, then alert only if ratio > 3 AND global_queue_rate > 20 req/s for 10m. reduces noise for tiny bursts.
Rahul (eng-infra): agree. Also suggest tying alert debounce to recent reclaim events (spot/eviction) — if cloud-event-count > 0 then extend debounce to 20m. avoids paging during region flaps.
Mike (eng-oncall): draft alert rule suggestion:
```yaml
- alert: RegionalQueueImbalance
  expr: queue_fairness_ratio{region="eu-west"} > 3 and sum(rate(requests_queued_total[5m])) by (region) > 20
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "High queue imbalance in {{ $labels.region }} (fairness ratio > 3)"
```
Anya (eng-platform): +1. also adding a dashboard panel that combines headroom heatmap and per-pool stall rate so SREs can quickly see if it's routing/capacity or a networking blip. proposed panel name: "Regional queue fairness + headroom".
deploy-bot: dashboard/eng-platform/queue-fairness patched (PR #3421) :white_check_mark:
Elaine (eng-sre): can someone add a note to runbook: when alert fires, check (1) recent scale events (2) cloud-reclaim events (3) routing policy logs; fallback is to temporarily force-equalize routing for 15m.
Rahul (eng-infra): i'll add the scheduling tweak to the canary next week and run a replay to validate.
Mike (eng-oncall): tagging @oncall for awareness during the next spike.
Anya (eng-platform): Action items:
- Rahul: implement queue_fairness_ratio metric + open PR (ETA 48h)
- Mike: add the alert rule with the extended debounce for cloud events (ETA 24h)
- Elaine: update runbook with diagnostic checklist and temporary mitigation steps (ETA 48h)
- Anya: wire new panel into SLO dashboard and add a short note on interpretations (ETA 72h)
Mike (eng-oncall): thx. want to avoid noisy pages during cost-driven regional shifts. :pray:
Rahul (eng-infra): noted. i'll post replay results here.
Anya (eng-platform): thanks — will monitor next ramp and follow up with a short postmortem if imbalance persists. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
